title: RANT Token — Reflection Token Manipulation Attack Analysis
root_cause: `_autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens()` is triggered on every non-pair transfer and calls `rant_center.updateAllAverage()` using the current LP balance; an attacker who holds a flash-loaned RANT position triggers this function while the LP balance reflects a manipulated state, skewing reward accounting in their favor
steps: 1 ▶ PancakeSwap CAKE LP: swap(large RANT amount) [flash loan]
2 ▶ Attacker temporarily becomes largest RANT holder
3 ▶ Induces other transfer transactions on the network, or self-transfers
4 ▶ Repays all RANT (or swaps to BNB and retains profit)
